column1: # render_coverage.tsv -- how the notebook page renders every value that can reach `--serve` ([P] Sec. 18.5 "coverage";
# slot-24 NB-RENDER R4). Gated by arm (R) of ConsoleReadOnlyTagValidation, in both directions:
#   * every core kind, every registered object type and every Record `schema` set in the verb sources has exactly
#     one row here, and every row names one of them;
#   * `tex`   -- notebook/page/render.js has a TeX renderer for it (a `case "<name>":` of toTeXRaw), and every
#               such case is marked tex here;
#   * `hint`  -- Console/serve/render_hints.tsv has at least one row for it (a typed piece of its tree is TeX),
#               and every name of that table is marked hint here;
#   * `table` -- the page's generic structure (a Record as a key/value table, a List of Records as a grid);
#   * `allow` -- shown as its canonical text (with a member table or a json view): an explicit decision, and the
#               reason column says why. `allow` combines with nothing.
# A new type or Record schema fails the gate until someone decides here how it renders.
# A Record without a `schema` field (theta(), iota(), ...) is a plain `Record`: a table whose leaves render by type.
# Columns (TAB-separated): name, class (kind | type | schema), render (tex, hint, table, allow; `+`-joined), reason.
